entries.alt: Four fictional adult women share side hugs on stepped seating above a curved harbor, white waterfront buildings and rocky hills. Cobalt, ivory and crimson, green, and copper short outfits pair with rainbow ankle boots, pumps, green RAZE boots and copper platforms. Star and IA tattoos are visible.
entries.selectionReason: Keeps four distinct faces and supported affection while improving the short fitted hems and bare-arm construction. Soft camera-scale and tattoo-assignment deviations retained without retry.

Copper, ivory, green and crimson short outfits, rainbow boots, silver platforms and star-marked stockings form the fashion scene.

entries.alt: In a close fictional fashion scene beneath a desert pavilion, four adult women lean into a hand-clasp conversation with dunes behind them. Three outfits use Oman's red, white and green flag pattern; the fourth is a green sculpted dress. GRD lettering, a rose and IA tattoo are visible.
entries.selectionReason: The Meta original preserves the intended tight framing and contact layout. The one ChatGPT result widened the crop to expose shoes, so that returned variant is archived unused.
